answer_1.quote: We show that our framework can enhance state-of-the-art language models in slang interpretation in English and slang translation from English to other languages... We apply the slang interpretation framework to neural machine translation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated definitions/paraphrases for slang terms and translated sentences containing interpreted slang

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the translated sentences using three metrics: 1) Sentence-level BLEU scores ... 2) BLEURT scores ... 3) COMET scores ... We also measure performance using mean reciprocal rank (MRR) for definition selection.
